description: GRAPH-RESIDENT: TIER 4 COGNITION (the graph's own model of its total collapse, domains/collapse_model.py's CollapseModel, USED by the agent -- not just measured) authored by the jabberwock via the composer (CLAUDE.md discipline: no hand-written agent rule). domains/collapse_model.py's predict_collapse is the MECHANICAL machinery (structural fixed-point/volatile-frontier enumeration + a bounded tier-3 forward-look) -- pure host measurement, never an agent decision, per that module's own docstring. domains/collapse_watch.py's scan_and_predict is the mechanical host hook that calls it periodically and wires `agent -has_collapse_model-> model` so the freshly-minted CollapseModel is exposed to the rule engine as a matchable edge (the SAME idiom domains/reflective_faculty.py's ensure_grounding_gap_edges uses to expose an already-computed GroundingGap flag). THIS seed is the agent's OWN decision about WHAT TO DO with the model, mirroring composer_grounding_guard_graph.json / composer_escalation_gate_graph.json / composer_imagination_graph.json's dual-process- arbitration shape exactly: mints THREE rules from an agent -wants_collapse_watch_rule-> ComposeRequest trigger (ground_concern's 'predict' relation head, seeds/relation_vocabulary.json's new collapse_watch cue + seeds/composer_dispatch.json's new ComposerCue, priority 20). (1) attend_frontier_<tag> is WHOLE-GRAPH META-SALIENCE: every node in the CollapseModel's own volatile_frontier sample (still collapsing -- an Observation/CapabilityAxis/Impasse/Goal not yet at a terminal status) gets an outgoing agent -attends_frontier-> node edge, guarded by that edge's own absence (never a set_attr on the frontier node itself). This is salience at the META level -- over the WHOLE collapse -- distinct from seeds/residual_salience.json's PER-AXIS salience (tier 2, frame-locked). (2) recognize_self_<tag> is the reflexive read: every node in the CollapseModel's own fixed_point sample (frozen_drive/frozen_seed/frozen_rule -- the frozen core domains/frozen_core.py proves unreachable -- PLUS the other structurally- settled categories) gets an outgoing agent -recognizes_as_self-> node edge, guarded the same way -- and, critically, NEVER set_attr's the matched node: the frozen Drive/Seed/RuleSummary nodes stay untouched by this rule, satisfying CLAUDE.md's 'reads fixed points, does not mutate the frozen Drive' discipline, and honouring domains/collapse_model.py's own self-inclusion invariant ('a CollapseModel node's own attrs are never mutated again after minting') by never touching cm's attrs either. (3) predict_intervene_<tag> is THE INTEGRATION HEADLINE: converged=false on the CollapseModel (the bounded forward-look predicts the volatile frontier grows without bound) mints an Impasse{kind:predicted_divergence} + agent -surprised_by-> impasse -- wired BOTH -about_model-> the CollapseModel (the honest link) AND -about_axis-> the SAME CollapseModel (piggy-backing composer_imagination_graph.json's own engage_imagine_cost_worth_<tag> rule: its kind-guard was widened, in this same change, from a single Eq to an Or of two Eq arms so a predicted_divergence-kind Impasse ALSO engages tier-3 imagination, not only seeds/autonomy.json's standing mint_goal_from_surprise -- which fires regardless of kind and needs no change at all). The un-checked add_edge target type is not schema-enforced by the engine (graph.insert_edge has no gate for rule-authored effects -- verified against runners/dsl/src/rewrite.rs's Effect::AddEdge handler), so reusing about_axis/focuses_on_axis with a CollapseModel target resolves correctly through domains/imagination_dispatch.py's existing `_resolve_focus` (which only needs a valid node id via that edge, never checks the target's TYPE) without touching that file. Re-fire is guarded by cm's own OUTGOING `escalated_divergence` edge (never a set_attr on cm, for the same self-inclusion reason). A converged=true CollapseModel never matches this rule's where-guard at all -- discriminative by construction, not by a second rule remembering to do nothing. Trust is the default (a converging graph is left alone); escalating to active cognition is what a genuinely PREDICTED divergence earns, BEFORE the runaway plays out.

effect.why: the whole-graph CollapseModel predicts the volatile frontier will grow without bound (converged=false) -- escalate to active cognition BEFORE the runaway plays out, not only after
